Resolves #21530

The Portal header now tells assistive technology which section is open: `Neo.app.header.Toolbar` owns a new reactive `activeId` config, renders `aria-current="page"` on the link with that id (and removes it from the previous one), and hands the same id to the header canvas, so the highlight keeps following the open section. `ViewportController#updateHeaderToolbar` sets the toolbar's `activeId` instead of the canvas's; the Viewport gives the toolbar a `header-toolbar` reference. Routes without a header link (`/about-us`, `/docs`) set `null`, so no link is marked. No migration; the canvas config is unchanged.

Evidence: L2 (unit spec `test/playwright/unit/app/HeaderToolbarActiveId.spec.mjs`, run locally) -> L2 required (AC-3 names a unit spec); AC-1/AC-2 on the live Portal were not run in a browser.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Spec "the open section's link renders aria-current=\"page\"..." and "switching sections moves the mark" pin one marked link that moves on the toolbar VDOM. The five routes were not clicked through on the live Portal. |
| AC-2 | Spec "null clears the mark" pins that no link carries `aria-current` when `activeId` is `null`, which is what the controller sets for `/about-us` and `/docs`. |
| AC-3 | `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/app/` -> 63 passed (after `npm run bundle-browser-deps`). |
| AC-4 | Spec "the header canvas receives the same id" pins the hand-over with a canvas stub (the real canvas needs a worker); the drawn highlight itself was not checked in a browser. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive.

## Test Evidence
- `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/app/` -> 63 passed locally (Node v22.23.4; the repo asks for >=24, npm warned EBADENGINE only).
- Reverse check: deleting the line that sets `aria-current` made 3 of the 5 new tests fail; deleting the line that clears the previous link made 2 fail.
- Not run: the full unit suite, lint, and a live-Portal check.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] On neomjs.com, `/`, `/learn`, `/news`, `/examples` and `/services` each show exactly one header link with `aria-current="page"`, and `/about-us` shows none.
